Several highly relevant Asian substrate and laminate names, including ITEQ, Taiwan Union Technology, Mitsubishi Gas Chemical, and Victory Giant, appear more directly tied to CCL/PCB/substrate materials but may lack convenient US listings or require separate non-US universe handling.

The key evidence bottleneck for this node is not generic glass fiber demand; it is proof of qualification in advanced package substrates, AI-server motherboards, 800G/1.6T switch boards, or next-generation low-Dk/Q-glass material stacks.
NBCLF should remain the reference anchor for advanced T-glass / NE-glass AI substrate research; direct evidence is stronger than for adjacent laminate or glass-core names.

ROG is a US-listed mid-cap candidate for the high-speed PCB laminate adjacency, but needs confirmation that AI-server/server-switch revenue is material and not merely generic high-speed networking exposure.
ASGLY belongs in speculative shadow memory for advanced glass-core / TGV substrate migration, not as confirmed current T-glass cloth exposure.
